⚠️ ENHANCED - Multi-format Google Slides reader with 99.6% token reduction!

Avoids token overflow with progressive format disclosure:
- summary (1K tokens): Slide titles, layouts, speaker notes preview, slide count
- text (80K tokens): All text content + complete speaker notes
- markdown (90K tokens): Slides as markdown sections with ##/### headings, bold/italic formatting
- full (280K+ tokens): Complete JSON with positioning/transforms (AVOID unless necessary)

Example responses:
✅ format='summary' (99.6% reduction for 24-slide deck):
"Presentation: **Q4 Sales Review** (24 slides)
Slides:
1. Title: 'Q4 Sales Review' | Layout: TITLE | Speaker Notes: 'Welcome everyone...'
2. Title: 'Agenda' | Layout: TITLE_AND_BODY | Notes: 'Cover 3 topics...'
..." (~1K tokens)

✅ format='text' (71% reduction):
"=== Slide 1: Q4 Sales Review ===
Subtitle: John Smith, VP Sales
Speaker Notes: Welcome everyone to our quarterly review..." (~80K tokens)

✅ format='markdown' (68% reduction):
"## Q4 Sales Review\n**John Smith, VP Sales**\n\n> Speaker Notes: Welcome everyone..." (~90K tokens)

❌ format='full' (AVOID - 280K+ tokens for 24 slides)

---

Get presentation details with format options. Prevents token overflow by defaulting to summary format. Font sizes determine heading levels in markdown (>=24pt = ##, >=18pt = ###).

format.description:
Response format (CRITICAL for token management):
- 'summary' (DEFAULT, 1K tokens): Slide titles, layout types, speaker notes preview, slide count. Use for quick overview or finding specific slides.
- 'text' (80K tokens): All text content from all slides + complete speaker notes. Use for full-text search or content analysis.
- 'markdown' (90K tokens): Slides as markdown sections with ## headings (font >=24pt), ### subheadings (font >=18pt), **bold**, *italic*. Speaker notes as blockquotes. Use for AI content processing or readable exports.
- 'full' (280K+ tokens): Complete JSON with shapes, positioning, transforms, images. AVOID unless you need layout metadata.

Default: 'summary'

examples.description: Get full text for content search
